interventions.detail: Created a Python 3.12 venv with uv (README only says to use a virtual environment) and installed the 0.8.0b1 pre-release that matches the repo
Started the server with --dev so it doesn't try to open a browser on a headless machine; run.sh polls / and /api/app-config until ready
The /api/tables/* endpoints need an X-Workspace-Id request header (any id, created on first use); the README doesn't mention this
